name: 66105 · Kansas City, KS
findings: ZIP 66105 (Kansas City) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66105 (Kansas City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 66105 (Kansas City) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.1 times the typical level).
